I replied to Ilse in her #north-random thread to confirm the correction: the 2026 Quarrendon Freight Lines renewal is 100 seats.

She said no action was needed, so I didn't change any record. My reply didn't repeat anything from her #north-team post, because some people in #north-random may not be in #north-team. The seat count is an operational fact, not a finance figure, and she had already posted it in #north-random herself.
